findings.title: Passage Database Column Mapping Discrepancy
findings.description: Integration test queries initially referenced ref_code and language instead of the Prisma schema and Migration 5 columns passage_ref_code and language_code, causing column does not exist errors during live PostgreSQL container execution.
findings.resolution: Updated test queries and server-side mapping to align strictly with passage_ref_code and language_code. All 7 passage database integration tests pass green.

findings.title: React 19 Cascading Render and Ref Mutation in LearningQuestionCard
findings.description: LearningQuestionCard utilized useEffect with setState and mutated isFinalizedRef during render to synchronize state upon question navigation, violating React 19 / eslint-plugin-react-hooks rules.
findings.resolution: Refactored state synchronization to the official React render-time pattern using prevOccurrenceId comparison and eliminated mutable ref manipulation. ESLint passed with 0 errors and 0 warnings.

findings.title: Missing COMPREHENSION_CHILD in EvaluatedQuestionType
findings.description: EvaluatedQuestionType in evaluation.ts was restricted to SINGLE_CORRECT, MULTIPLE_CORRECT, and ASSERTION_REASON, causing TypeScript compiler errors when rendering passage-linked questions.
findings.resolution: Extended EvaluatedQuestionType with COMPREHENSION_CHILD and enhanced normalizeQuestionType to inspect options (evaluating as multiple-correct if >1 correct option configured, or single-correct otherwise). tsc --noEmit passed with 0 errors.

gates_enforced: Gate 2: Unique option labels per question
Gate 3: Explicit question type stored (no inference)
Gate 4: Single-correct requires exactly 1 correct option
Gate 5: Multiple-correct requires at least 1 correct option and enforces strict all-or-nothing scoring
Gate 6: Assertion-reason requires non-empty assertion and reason text with exactly 1 correct choice
Gate 7: COMPREHENSION_CHILD requires mandatory linked passage (passage_id / passage_ref_code)
Gate 8: Immutability triggers block modifying or deleting passages and questions once paper is PUBLISHED
Gate 9: Local disposable test database isolation (127.0.0.1:5433) with zero remote mutations
